# DeepScaleTool Reference Workbook

`DeepScaleTool.xlsm` is the original workbook distributed by the
DeepScaleTool project on SourceForge. Its SHA256 is
`561a3f8f5e91a3c496d6e0f4262c09412209f3bbc6d22b714cde323ebd958df8`.

Source: `https://sourceforge.net/projects/deepscaletool/`

The workbook is distributed under GPLv3. The complete license text is retained
as `LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt`, with SHA256
`3972dc9744f6499f0f9b2dbf76696f2ae7ad8af9b23dde66d6af86c9dfb36986`.
The SCARF command does not execute workbook macros. It implements the published
node tables non-interactively and verifies the original workbook hash before
normalization.
